page.overview:
Who is Davies?

(possibly an alias) is the half-elven proprietor of Natural Remedies in Trostenwald.

"Davies" is a tan-skinned, half-elven man with dark hair that is a bit ratty and clustered.

"Davies" is a rather shady individual and it is implied he uses his own supply of drugs and performance-enhancing fungus.
